fields.body: Crew called the last 80 feet of north-loop trench extra during toolbox talk because it was beyond yesterday’s stakes. Today we completed that 80 feet and used the scheduled excavator. No route or depth changed.
Original issued C-08 includes 480 linear feet of north-loop trench, including the final 80 feet from station N4 to N5. Tender revision unchanged.

The 400 feet previously installed plus today’s 80 feet equals the original 480-foot scope. No additional alignment, quantity or method has been instructed. N4-N5 was missed in the crew’s daily stakeout, not the contract.
